cover.description: The season's cover (owner 2026-10-02: covers are per season; a toon is represented by its avatar): text-free art + the lettering layout, language-neutral like `download` / `trailer` (the creator's cover editor writes it to every locale). The toon page shows the cover of the season it presents.

download.description: the season's downloads (the music album), shown below its chapter list

supporters.description: who supported the season, in order: "Supported by" at the end of the reader's credits fine print

trailer.description: the toon page's desktop hero: a muted background loop + the button to the trailer chapter (language-neutral)

related_items.description: Items that go with this season (catalog item ids, in order; language-neutral like `download` – the creator writes the same list to every locale): the toon page's "related" block (icon, name, and for physical items with a product the link to buy it), agents/ITEMS.md "Players, albums, related items".

credits.deprecated: moved to `<toon>/_/credits.json` (the creator shows it read-only); the viewer never rendered it

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

status.description: visibility of the chapter per locale (a toon may release de before en)

LocaleStatus.description: A per-language value that is not a text (season `sequence[].status`)

lettering.description: the image is lettering-free: the UI renders the title over it (default false = shown as it is). `true` = the default layout (the toon's name small, the season's title big in quotes); an object = a layout per format from the creator's cover editor (`CoverLettering`, cover.ts) – texts from the text fields, never baked

Cover.description: A toon's / season's cover (language-neutral, owner 2026-10-01: media are shared by all languages). The artwork carries no text: with `lettering` the UI sets the title lines over it in the reader's language (`CoverArt` in `@scutoons/reader`, agents/DATA.md "Language-independent media"). Without it the image is shown as it is – for artwork that still has its title baked in (catpope until the lettering-free cover is delivered).

CoverLettering.description: a layout per format; a format without lines uses the default layout

text.description: the text: the toon's title, the season's title, or `custom`

custom.description: the line's own text per language (only with `text: 'custom'`), e.g. { de: "Staffel 1", en: "Season 1" }

x.description: the centre of the line's box in % of the cover's width

y.description: the centre of the line's box in % of the cover's height

size.description: font size in % of the cover's width (the lettering scales with the art)

maxWidth.description: the line's box width in % of the cover's width: a longer text (a translation) shrinks to fit it

rotate.description: degrees, negative = tilted up to the right like the hand-lettered catpope cover

align.description: the text inside its box (default center)

CoverLine.description: One line of lettering. Geometry is language-neutral; the text comes from a text field (never baked).

music.description: the music album (a zip), path in the toon's CDN folder; no path = no download

complete.description: everything of the season in one file, if there is one

image.description: decorative image beside the reader's music button (e.g. the record's cut-out), path in the toon's CDN folder

Download.description: A season's downloads (the reader's `/<toon>/download` page, linked below the season's chapter list)

logo.description: logo image path in the toon's CDN folder (like the season's other images)

Supporter.description: A supporter of a season (a logo row at the end of the credits fine print; without a logo its name as text)

loop.description: CDN path of the muted background loop (H.264 MP4, no audio track needed); the default file

variants.description: Other encodings of the loop per media quality, like slice videos (owner 2026-10-02: no media queries to type) – the reader's quality setting picks one (`pickQualityVariant`), `loop` when none fits.

sources.deprecated: older data: encodings with a media query – still played when there are no `variants`

poster.description: CDN path of the poster image (shown before the loop plays and with reduced motion)

chapter.description: the chapter the trailer buttons open, default 0 (the prologue)

SeasonTrailer.description: The season's trailer on the toon page (owner 2026-10-01, desktop hero): a short muted montage looping behind the title, and "Trailer ansehen" / "Ton an" open the trailer chapter (the prologue) with sound. Language-neutral like `download`.

QualityVariants.description: One file per quality level (CDN paths like `src`); a missing level falls back (`pickQualityVariant`).

SliceVideoSource.description: One encoding of the season trailer's loop: a CDN path + an optional media query (`<source media>`)

Credits.deprecated: moved to `<toon>/_/credits.json` (`ToonCredits`, credits.ts); the creator shows it read-only
